title: Guava: modeled ₹1,026/qtl left, Solan → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: January 2024: reported guava prices at Solan and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 18 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,026 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 124 same-variety market pairs screened for guava in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Solan (Himachal Pradesh) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported guava prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 18 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Solan reported a median ₹3,500 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹5,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,350/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,350 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 189 km by road
scenes.caption: 189 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹41/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹826 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹574 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 18 of 18 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,026 per quintal (₹765 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Guava route from Solan to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹102,600, or ₹76,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to guava
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹41/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Guava route from Solan to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹102,600, or ₹76,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to guava
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹32/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Guava route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 92% of matched days in December 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹80,600, or ₹55,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
